article.story: Utah Jazz vs. Memphis Grizzlies Memphis, Tennessee; Wednesday, 8 p.m. EDT LINE: Grizzlies -1.5; over/under is 242.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Memphis Grizzlies host the Utah Jazz for the season opener. Memphis finished 25-57 overall and 19-33 in Western Conference action last season. The Grizzlies averaged 8.8 steals, 4.8 blocks and 14.6 turnovers per game last season. Utah went 22-60 overall and 12-40 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Jazz averaged 117.6 points per game while shooting 46.7% from the field and 34.5% from 3-point distance last season. INJURIES: Grizzlies: Isaiah Stewart: out (ankle). Jazz: Jusuf Nurkic: out (foot). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
